interpretation_note: In the common May 2025 tracked-app snapshot, the bundle-adjacent YouTube Music side leads Melon by 13.4813 percentage points in app-usage share, supporting a discovery and attention concentration proxy.

Against the same-country basket of Premium Lite plus Melon regular, the full YouTube bundle undercuts by KRW 2290, indicating a durable bundle-side pull on future consumer and bargaining position.

Export-facing prestige and chart visibility remain dependent on foreign-owned scoreboards, which can shape future bargaining power even if this is not the same thing as domestic average market burden.
